summary: Verify Brightness level is visible after navigating to Display settings
description: Manual regression test case for the Display settings screen on the Android Automotive (Android Auto) head unit. Confirms the Brightness control is reachable from the Settings app and is no longer visible after navigating away to Sound settings.
preconditions: Device/emulator is powered on and unlocked
No dialogs or system notifications are blocking the screen

testSteps.expectedResult: Display settings screen opens and 'Brightness level' is visible
Sound settings screen opens and 'Brightness level' is no longer visible
